author: Ymnes
attribution: Photo: Ymnes, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Verkeersbord,_Afobakaweg.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Weathered company billboard on the Afobakaweg with four arrow-shaped direction panels over a photo of smiling workers (photo faces are part of the print, not the subject). Seen from the roadside at a distance. Distractors: 'PLEASE DRIVE SAFE' tag, 'Supporting our community' strip, a small 'BROWNSWEG' fingerpost at far left and partly hidden boards below ('...ier Plant...'). location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: -JvL-
attribution: Photo: -JvL-, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Information_sign_of_Fort_Zeelandia_(31115831872).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.

lines.text: PARAMARIBO | Historic Inner City | Historische Binnenstad

notes: Tall bilingual Dutch/English heritage board at Fort Zeelandia, Paramaribo (UNESCO World Heritage logos top right: 'PATRIMOINE MONDIAL / WORLD HERITAGE / WERELDERFGOED'). Only the headers are transcribed; long body text and a small site map ('Plattegrond / Map of Fort Zeelandia', 'SURINAMERIVIER') follow. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Mark Ahsmann
attribution: Photo: Mark Ahsmann, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Kwakoeplein_street_sign.JPG. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: White wooden cross-bar street sign with black stencilled letters in Paramaribo, shot from below against the sky.

author: Mark Ahsmann
attribution: Photo: Mark Ahsmann, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Street_sign_in_Paramaribo_II.JPG. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Old hand-lettered distance fingerpost in central Paramaribo (left board westbound, right board eastbound, km). Top lines are faded and the right board is partly in shadow. A third board above is edge-on. Distractors: 'GARAGE DE PAARL' van, red '...SS ...RIVAP...' shop lettering behind, traffic in front.

author: Brokopondo
attribution: Photo: Brokopondo, Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Lelydorp2010.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Weathered white place-name board on a roadside frame at Lelydorp (Kofi-Djompo is the local name). Distractors: yellow LOTTO billboard ('VOLGENDE JACKPOT SRD. 450.000'), 'drempel' sign, pedestrian and traffic incidental.

author: tjabeljan
attribution: Photo: tjabeljan, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:SurinameFortNieuwAmsterdam006_(8194911927).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Yellow wooden street board with black stencilled letters on a concrete post near Fort Nieuw Amsterdam; a full rubbish rack beside it.

author: tjabeljan
attribution: Photo: tjabeljan, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:NieuwNickerie027_(8058933567).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Two raised-letter name panels on the tax office in Nieuw Nickerie (upper on the first-floor parapet, lower over the entrance). Small 'NO SMOKING' sign on the door.

author: tjabeljan
attribution: Photo: tjabeljan, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:NieuwNickerie032_(8058932950).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hand-painted butcher's shop fascia in Nieuw Nickerie with crescent moons and a halal roundel. The opening-hours line is cut off at the air-conditioner on the right; a longer painted paragraph on the wall is partly hidden by a column. 'Juwelier Ramdaran Avinash' gilt window lettering is a distractor (partly hidden).

author: Mark Ahsmann
attribution: Photo: Mark Ahsmann, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Entrance_sign_of_Nola_Hatterman_Instituut.JPG. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Rustic plank sign with white stencilled letters and a brass-lettered strip below, at the art academy in Paramaribo; red wagon-wheel hay rake beside it.
source_title: File:Entrance sign of Nola Hatterman Instituut.JPG

author: Dan Sloan
attribution: Photo: Dan Sloan, CC BY-SA 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Jodensavanne_(Jewish_Savanna)_(23747540622).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Bilingual Dutch/English heritage board at the synagogue ruin in Jodensavanne; only the two headers are transcribed. Body text, captions ('...Beracha ve Shalom, oftewel Zegen en Vrede.'), 'Stichting Jodensavanne' and World Monuments Fund footer follow. Board is stained and has stray bullet-like holes.

author: Bart van Poll
attribution: Photo: Bart van Poll, CC BY-SA 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Butcher_Paramaribo_market.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hand-painted hanging stall sign (pig, star, palm-tree drawings) at the Paramaribo market; 'PARADYS' uses the Surinamese Y for IJ. Distractors: smaller 'ZOUTVLEES' boards, A-frame 'GEACHTE KLANTEN HIER IS SOWTU' and a second A-frame with small text; vendors and passers-by incidental.

author: Willem van de Poll
attribution: Photo: Willem van de Poll, CC0 1.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:De_kerk_van_Uitkijk_met_het_gemeentebord,_Bestanddeelnr_252-6433.jpg. License: http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/deed.en. Unmodified original.
notes: 1947 black-and-white photo of the plantation name board of Uitkijk on the Saramacca river, framed on two posts, with a wooden church behind.
